migration_risks: Older C-drive clients and USER_VERA_ROOT aliases now fail instead of silently reading obsolete state.
The historical PCCC_WRITE_ROOT_V1 identifier is retained for API diagnostics, but any runtime-write resolution fails closed.
This is an incompatible source-policy change for callers expecting a writable PCCC path; no replacement D-drive write location has been authorized.
Read policy is lexical only; Windows host must validate actual handles, reparse points, ACLs, trusted identity and current root state before any read.
Source changes do not migrate existing C-drive files or verify D-drive data, deployments, signatures or host permissions.
An old installed package can retain old C-drive behavior until separately updated and independently verified.
non_effects: no user account or ACL change
no network or remote host action
no production deployment or memory admission
